title: Turn off Apple Intelligence on macOS 27 and get its disk space back
why_read: A niche but concrete how-to on reclaiming disk space from Apple Intelligence models, useful mainly to macOS power users.
analysis: This is a practical tip post explaining how to disable Apple Intelligence features on a future macOS version to free up disk space consumed by on-device AI models. It's useful and specific but fairly narrow in scope, appealing mostly to macOS users concerned about storage. The mention of 'macOS 27' suggests either a typo or far-future speculation, which should be read with some caution. Technically it's a minor systems/configuration tip rather than a deep technical story.
